effect_en: Add 3000 Power to 1 of your in-play MAMODO cards during the next turn. This effect is [STANDBY] until the START PHASE of the next turn, and [STAY] during the next turn.
[STAY] Both players cannot play any SPELL cards until the END PHASE of the next turn.
Get 2 MP.
Reduce both players' MP to 0. ※ When either player has 1 or more MP, this effect is considered to be reducing a player's MP.
Flip a coin twice; • If you get heads twice, turn back 2 pages of your Spell Book. • If you get heads and tails, there is no effect. • If you get tails twice, turn 2 pages of your Spell Book.

Select 1 of your in-play MAMODO cards and flip a coin; if it's heads, turn the selected MAMODO card to Normal Status. If it's tails, add 1000 Power to the selected MAMODO card during this turn ([STAY]).
Turn 1 of your Injured MAMODO cards to Normal Status.
[STAY] Both players cannot apply the effects of their in-play PARTNER cards during this turn.
[STAY] Add 3000 Power to 1 of your in-play MAMODO cards during this turn.

[STANDBY] Select 1 of your opponent's in-play PARTNER cards without [In Play]. You can apply the effects of the selected PARTNER card as your own once during this turn (any PARTNER cards used through this effect with [Send this card to the Discard Pile] remain in play after applying their effects).
Flip a coin; if it's heads, move 1 PARTNER card from your Discard Pile into play. If it's tails, you may pay 2 MP to re-do the coin toss until you get heads.
Select 1 MAMODO card from any page of your Spell Book and put it in play.
[STANDBY] Your opponent can neither SACRIFICE nor PROTECT their Spell Book from Damage during the next Battle this turn.

Look at your opponent's Spell Book. Select 1 SPELL card from any page (except the last page) and send it to the Discard Pile. Then, reduce your MP equal to the MP cost of the selected SPELL card (if you have less MP than that card's cost, reduce your MP to 0).

Look at your opponent's Spell Book. Select 1 EVENT card from any page and send it to the Discard Pile. Then, reduce your MP equal to the MP cost of the selected EVENT card (if you have less MP than that EVENT card's cost, reduce your MP to 0).
Reduce your opponent's MP by 4. If you applied an effect that reduced your opponent's MP on the previous turn, no MP is reduced.
